name: GetFileVersions
description: Retrieves the version history of a file in Microsoft 365 SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and retrieve file versions in SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint file URL to retrieve versions for (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/File.txt).

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the version history of the file, including version IDs, modified dates, and metadata for each version.
